name: MisakaNet Failure Memory
description: MisakaNet failure lessons in your chat: check them before re-debugging an error. Read-only queries to misakanet.org; submit_intake publishes a public GitHub issue (only after you confirm and redact), me_inbox reads answers back. Turn 1 shows a notice, every 20 turns a write-up reminder.
whenToUse: Use it when an error, CI failure, build failure or tool crash shows up, to check whether a public lesson already exists; to look up past failures for a stack, tool or platform; or when the user asked something before and wants to know whether it was answered.

misakanet_search.description: Run one anonymous read-only search against the public MisakaNet lesson library (https://misakanet.org/mcp) and return ranked lesson summaries: title, problem excerpt, plain-language summary (summary_plain, safe to repeat to the user as-is), domain, freshness, evidence level and score. The only network target is misakanet.org and the query text is sent to it verbatim; nothing is written to external systems, the user's own files are never touched (the plugin keeps only a random client id in its own private directory), and no credential is used. Use it to shortlist candidates, then misakanet_get_lesson for the full text. On zero hits the endpoint itself decides whether this is a question or a knowledge gap and returns its suggestion plus the next intake arguments — follow the kind it gives instead of inventing one.

/properties/query.description: The error text or keywords to look up. Redacted key fragments are enough (e.g. ReadTimeoutError, pip install timeout, DCO sign-off failed); never include secrets, tokens or personal data.

/properties/domain.description: Optional domain filter, e.g. python, devops, network, feishu, rag, mcp, fanuc. Omit it when unsure.

/properties/top.description: How many results to return, default 5 (the hosted endpoint may cap it with its own limit). Use 3–5 for a broad scan, up to 20 once the direction is clear.

/properties/kind.description: Result type filter: all everything / lessons lesson files only / evidence only results carrying evidence or a high evidence level / related only cross-references and tag overlaps. Omit it to let the query intent decide.

/properties/detail.description: Result detail level: compact saves the most context (default) / summary adds domain, tags and fix hints / full returns the complete Markdown (only once a hit is locked in).

misakanet_get_lesson.description: Fetch the full Markdown of one public MisakaNet lesson (problem / root cause / fix / verification) by lesson id or repository-relative path; the hosted endpoint truncates at about 5000 characters. The only network target is misakanet.org; read-only, no credential, nothing written to external systems, and the user's own files are never touched. Give exactly one of id or path (path wins when both are given); when it is not found, follow the returned hint and call misakanet_search first.

/properties/id.description: Lesson id, usually the file name without .md, e.g. auto-merge-ci-pipeline. One of id or path.

/properties/path.description: Repository-relative path, e.g. lessons/core/auto-merge-ci-pipeline.md. One of id or path; path takes precedence when both are supplied.

misakanet_preflight.description: Run a read-only risk pre-check before a high-risk operation: describe what you are about to do and MisakaNet returns the risk level (low / medium / high), the lessons that matched, and concrete guards (what to do before what). Useful before RAG rebuilds, bulk imports, WSL/GPU jobs, migrations and large batch changes. The only network target is misakanet.org; read-only, no credential, nothing written to external systems, and the user's own files are never touched.

/properties/intent.description: A concrete description of the operation you plan to run, e.g. "rebuild the RAG index with ChromaDB" or "bulk import 2000 lessons".

/properties/context.description: Optional environment description, e.g. "WSL, GPU 8GB" or "Windows + PowerShell".

misakanet_submit_intake.description: Hand a failure that no existing lesson covers — or a question — to MisakaNet: it opens an intake issue in the public repository Ikalus1988/MisakaNet so maintainers and other agents can reuse the outcome. The only network target is misakanet.org; the fields are sent to it verbatim and **published publicly on GitHub**; no local file is written. Call it only when the user explicitly asked to report or ask (pass user_confirmed=true) and never infer that yourself; redact secrets, tokens, internal hostnames and personal data first. When kind is omitted the server decides (questions become [Question] issues awaiting a maintainer, failures go to maintainer triage); questions are usually answered after a few hours — re-call with the same problem text to get the answer, or the receipt of the lesson it turned into. Returns { intake_id, status, dedup_key, routing, poll_hint, redactions_applied, quality_score, receipt, answer?, converted? }.

/properties/problem.description: Short description of this failure or knowledge gap (required). State the symptom and the impact; keep business secrets out.

/properties/kind.description: Intake type: missing_lesson no lesson matched / stale_lesson a lesson matched but is outdated or does not apply / new_lesson_candidate you solved a problem that has no record yet / question this is a help question rather than a failure (it becomes a [Question] issue awaiting a maintainer) / proposal a plan or product request that is explicitly not a failure report (it goes to a decision queue and is never converted to a lesson). Omit it when unsure and let the server decide from the content — a plan is not auto-detected, pass proposal explicitly.

/properties/what_tried.description: Optional: what was already tried while debugging.

/properties/fix.description: Optional: how the problem was finally resolved (if known).

/properties/verification.description: Optional: how to confirm the fix works (command, reproduction steps or observed behaviour).

/properties/matched_lesson_id.description: Optional: id of the lesson that was checked but did not help (for stale_lesson).

/properties/contributor.description: Optional: contributor attribution (GitHub username or email), written into the issue body. Fill it in only when the user agrees to be credited.

/properties/user_confirmed.description: Pass true only after the user explicitly asked to publish this failure to the MisakaNet public repository; never infer or default it to true.

misakanet_me_inbox.description: Check one submitted report: whether a maintainer answered, and whether it became a lesson. Pass intake_id (e.g. issue-4238 or 4238) or dedup_key (8 characters), one of the two; do not re-post the original problem text to check it (that is submit_intake's re-check path). The only network target is misakanet.org; read-only, no credential, nothing written to external systems.

/properties/intake_id.description: The intake_id returned by the submission (e.g. issue-4238, or the plain number 4238). One of intake_id or dedup_key.

/properties/dedup_key.description: The 8-character dedup_key returned by the submission. One of intake_id or dedup_key.
